# lokalise Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "lokalise" {
  # token can also be set via the LOKALISE_API_TOKEN environment variable
  token = "example-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) Lokalise API base URL. Defaults to https://api.lokalise.com/api2.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Lokalise API token. May also be set via the LOKALISE_API_TOKEN environment variable.
